tasks.title: Route by-value duckdb_result functions through numbox's ABI-aware _call_lib_func

tasks.rationale: _call_lib_func_byval lowers func(T*) semantics and omits the SysV x86-64 byval stack copy, so the 48-byte result is read from stale stack; today it works only by coincidence and can silently corrupt the core result-fetch path.

tasks.title: Add a duckdb library-coordination / single-runtime guard for the standalone fallback
